dogfooding.required: author a real workflow and IR round-trip it without semantic drift
run one workflow through two supported host/capability classes
inspect a real run and reconstruct execution from evidence
teach a real operator one task from an installed workflow
compile and execute one real authored workflow
automate one useful computer task end-to-end on a real host
execute one controlled scheduled trigger and one event trigger where supported
install a real workflow and use it to teach a human, then execute it
compare baseline and optimized versions on the same real task
fork/modify/publish/install and perform a safe test transaction
use WorkflowOS to install and execute a WorkflowOS development workflow

rules.hardDependencyGate: all hardDependencies must be COMPLETE before activation
rules.completionGate: implementation + verification + dogfooding evidence + sole architect merge
rules.stateAuthority: this file is V2 development state; v1 state remains authoritative for v1
rules.dogfoodingFailure: blocks dependent activation when contract-relevant; otherwise creates a corrective Work Order and preserves the observation
rules.parallelism: sequential by default; parallel waves require explicit non-conflicting change surfaces
rules.history: append correction records; never rewrite empirical findings
rules.versioning: a Work Order cannot silently redefine a frozen V2 protocol concept
